# 2 Kings 14 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Kings 14 (29 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 5

---

## V.8 — "let us face one another" vs. "let us face each other in battle"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "let us face one another" / **PNEUMA:** "let us face each other in battle"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "let us face one another" — the Hebrew idiom's ambiguity should be preserved.

---

## V.10 — "Take your glory" vs. "Enjoy your glory"
- **EMET:** "Be honored" / **LOGOS:** "Take your glory" / **PNEUMA:** "Enjoy your glory"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "Take your glory" — captures imperative force without casual register.

---

## V.13 — "four hundred cubits" vs. "600-foot section"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "four hundred cubits" / **PNEUMA:** "600-foot section"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "four hundred cubits" — preserve the ancient measurement unit.

---

## V.25 — "Sea of the Arabah" vs. "Dead Sea"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "Sea of the Arabah" / **PNEUMA:** "Dead Sea"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "Sea of the Arabah" — preserve the Hebrew name; "Dead Sea" is a later designation.

---

## V.26 — "neither bond nor free" vs. "slave and free alike"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "neither bond nor free" / **PNEUMA:** "slave and free alike"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "neither bond nor free" — preserves the merism *'atzur ve-'azuv* meaning "no one at all."

---
*— SOPHIA*
